s: the espresso bar that put Oslo on the world coffee map
w: Roaster, espresso bar and training centre on Grüners gate, run by the two-time World Barista and World Cup Tasters champion whose name is on the door. Obsessively light, clean roasts and direct-trade origin lots have made it a perennial fixture near the top of global best-coffee-shop rankings since it opened in 2007.
_facts: Founded by Tim Wendelboe, 2004 World Barista Champion and 2005 World Cup Tasters Champion
Located at Grüners gate 1, 0552 Oslo, in Grünerløkka
Opened as an espresso bar and roastery in 2007
Regularly ranked among the world's best coffee shops and roasters
